segments.text: Respond to reviews and boost revenue by 35 percent.
segments.narration: Respond to reviews and boost revenue by 35 percent. Bad reviews are not a death sentence for your business.
Businesses that reply to at least 25 percent of their reviews average 35 percent more revenue than those that stay silent (Source: WiserReview).
53 percent of customers expect a response to a negative review within one week, and 1 in 3 expects a reply within three days or less (Source: ReviewTrackers).
Please reach out to us at so we can resolve this personally." That is about 60 words.
70 percent of unhappy customers will return and do business with a company again if their complaint is resolved in their favor (Source: Help Scout).
56 percent of consumers changed their opinion about a business based on how the owner responded to a review (Source: BrightLocal).
Hold a short team meeting, ten minutes maximum, and walk through the most common complaints you have received in the past 90 days.
